preconditions.description: Number of rows in the flag matrix is between 1 and 10.
Number of columns in the flag matrix is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of segments is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= flag[i][j] <= 1000000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in the flag matrix are positive integers not exceeding 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= m for l, r in segments)
preconditions.description: For each segment, the left border l is between 1 and m, and the right border r is between l and m.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of segments.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(beauty, int) and beauty >= 0 for beauty in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the beauty of the segment.
